notes.title: Bacon Rebellion Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello!
If you liked any of my previous games, I thought to let you know that my newest game - Bacon Rebellion is out now!
It's a small and silly top-down shooter game about angry rampaging pigs. Grab your shotgun and put an end to this Bacon Rebellion!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/415780/Bacon_Rebellion/

notes.title: The Inner Darkness - released!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

If you enjoyed There Was a Caveman or any other of my games, you should know that I just released my newest game The Inner Darkness.
It is a mysterious puzzle platformer with a dimension switching mechanic.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/562160/

It's right now on a 20% launch discount too. Anyway, check it out!

Thanks a lot!

Nauris

notes.title: The Dark Within
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

My newest game [b]The Dark Within is now on Greenlight![/b]

If you liked any of my previous games I think you might enjoy this one too!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=770836638

P.S To those who are interested in Bacon Rebellion, the game has not been cancelled, I am still working on it, and it's not far from finished. The Dark Within, is just a smaller side-project I worked on!

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Hi,

I've got a nice surprise for all you Achievement Hunters! I've added achievement support for There Was a Caveman! You can now play the game to try and earn 19 achievements, some easy, some hard, and some just requiring some time and dedication. 

I hope you enjoy the achievements, I might add some more interesting ones in the future. :)

Thanks,

Nauris

notes.title: Hotfix update
notes.content:
Hi,

I've updated the game trying to fix some of the key issues people had with the game, like not being able to change gamepad keys or some frustrating gameplay elements.

[b]The changes include -[/b]
[list]
[*]You now have a new menu option to define your gamepad controls.
[*]Fixed the bug where you would stop moving with the moving platforms when attacking.
[*]Fixed the issue with people not being able to correctly grip the vines.
[*]Tweaked the mammoth boss fight, to make it more forgiving.
[*]Tweaked some cheap enemy placement and removed the worms in forest stages completely.
[*]Changed the way the acid balls pop out of the river in afterlife stages. They're now less random.
[*]Changed how much skulls the health upgrade costs.[/list]

I hope now you have a little better experience!

Nauris
